Why Creatives Choose It

Your Direction Stays Yours

Output follows your references, palette, and tags — because you set them. It accelerates the work; it doesn't overwrite it.

One Canvas, No Tool-Hopping

Collect, compose, generate, and comment in one place. Stop bleeding context between Pinterest, a generator, and Figma.

Built for Iteration

Pin comments anywhere, version freely, share a board link. It works the way critique already works.

Quick Answers

Is my work private?+
Yes. Your boards and uploads are yours. Nothing you create is shared or used to train models without your say-so.
Will this replace my process?+
No. It removes the grind around gathering and iterating so you spend more time directing. You stay the creative; the canvas keeps up.
Can I export to the tools I already use?+
Send compositions to Figma, download clean assets, or share a live board link. It slots into your pipeline rather than replacing it.
How do I get started?+
Simply sign up at app.moodblendy.com/signup. You can immediately create your first board, bring in references, and start generating visuals.
